- The addition of the **mockito-all** dependency in **pom.xml** suggests that the testing framework is being enhanced, likely to facilitate better unit testing practices, including the new test case added in **TestJavaActionExecutor.java**.
- The new test case in **TestJavaActionExecutor.java** is designed to validate the fix implemented in **LauncherMapper.java**, ensuring that the application behaves correctly when empty arguments are encountered, thus confirming the effectiveness of the patch.
